newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA RAND HUGS 4.50, BONDS QUIET TOWARD CLOSE.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA RAND HUGS 4.50, BONDS QUIET TOWARD CLOSE.

text.p: 1430 GMT - South African rand hugging narrow range either side of 4.50 level which was broken around midday. Bonds a tad higher in torpid late Monday dealings.
* Rand last at 4.5000/5030 from 4.4830/4860 Friday after London order and local selling took it through 4.50 around 1000 GMT. Unit last above 4.5000 on February 5.
* Dealers say rand likely to remain nervous in lead up to July 1 relaxation of exchange controls on individuals.
* Upside limit seen set by Reserve Bank, which was said to have offered dollars at 4.5050 to head off move to 4.5100.
* R150 yielding 14.590 pct from 14.615 Friday with single late buy order keeping bond in positive territory.
* Debt players looking to rand as best indicator of near term sentiment.
* Market faces April PPI figure on Tuesday which is expected to come in a touch lower from March.
